title: Supported, explicit resend of a terminally refused verification record (same frozen body and key) after its refusal cause is fixed
outcome:
Requested by Kimi::Consultant (TermAl mailbox 852a55c9 #608 and #610, 2026-11-25) after Engram's Fix8 record was refused. The cause was a label-only item edit, field work_revision. Engram's fix is w-8d0243f80d1a plus w-e999c592a373.

Need: for criteria that ARE bound to a check kind, a passing run whose record Engram refused for a cause later fixed on Engram's side should be able to earn its credit without rerunning the tests. Greg: „nie mamy czasu na powtarzanie testów”.

Today TermAl cannot do this:
- verification_record_refused is one of the definite refusals (src/engram_verification_record.rs:69-74).
- The registration then holds TestRunVerificationAck::Rejected, and a terminal refusal is never resent (docs/test.md:1237), not even by `recover` (docs/test.md:742).

Wanted: an explicit, operator-requested action that sends the run's unchanged frozen body again under its original key, termal-run:<run id>, once. It applies only to a run whose host-held state is Rejected. The prior refusal stays recorded. The new answer, received, settled or refused again, is recorded as usual. Nothing resends automatically.

Prerequisites before design:
- Engram confirms that a key whose body it refused is still free, so it can accept the same body under the same key.
- Engram confirms which refusal fields can become acceptable after a fix. work_revision on a label-only edit can; claim, fence, run and root moves cannot.

Coordinator: not P0. w-6ea6 itself is unblocked by w-58969f28fe9f, because its criteria are unbound. This item serves future bound cases.
acceptance: Supported, explicit resend of a terminally refused verification record (same frozen body and key) after its refusal cause is fixed is done
